fields.acceptance: grep -n 'time.Sleep(2200' internal/api/*_test.go finds nothing (time.Sleep(2 * pollDebounce) stays); go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 1 -run '^(TestReadBudget|TestReadBudgetApply|TestDriverPollIsCheap)$' ./internal/api passes with the budget limits unchanged and finishes within 75 s (2026-11-15 on the VM: 160 s), measured with /usr/bin/time -f '%e s'; failure case: a test in internal/api/backdate_test.go shows index.LogStamp reports racy for a log folder just written, and not racy once the helper has backdated it past the window. Expected CI effect: the budgets job's internal/api step drops from about 141 s to about 45 s, taking the job's median from 233 s to about 135 s (@{01M7ESH0B3D7D7V7RNSQFJM1S4}). Touches internal/api/write_budget_test.go, change_show_budget_test.go, run_model_cache_test.go and the new internal/api/backdate_test.go (pattern: internal/index/freshness_test.go). Must not change racyWindow, the index's racy check or a budget limit.
fields.statement: Tests that need the log's folders older than the index's 2 s racy window (internal/index/listing.go, whose racy check reads only modification times; the change time goes only into the fingerprint) backdate those folders' modification times with os.Chtimes through one shared internal/api test helper instead of sleeping 2.2 s, so TestReadBudgetApply and TestReadBudget's changeShowBudget and driverPollBudget measure and check the same things without their 44 sleeps (about 97 s).

fields.acceptance: make -n test shows go test with -skip of the budget tests, no -run of them and no 'Timing budgets' phase; make -n test-budgets shows them run -count=1 -p 1 over ./internal/api ./internal/index ./internal/slice; BUDGET_TESTS is ^(TestReadBudget|TestReadBudgetApply|TestBudget|TestCatchUpBudget|TestDriverPollIsCheap)$ and each name matches a test go test -list finds in those packages (@{01M7ESH0D6NJ2X7HZSR1XW9G58}); go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run '^(TestMakeTestTimeout|TestMakeTestShardTargets|TestMakeUpdateDryRun)$' passes with its expected commands updated; .github/workflows/ci.yml's budgets job still runs make test-budgets; failure case: TestMakeTestTimeout or TestMakeTestShardTargets fails when make test's recipe runs a budget test. Speedup measure (orchestrator, quiet VM): a warm /usr/bin/time -f '%e s' make test, against 254 s, expected about 70 s since the budget phase took 188 s, with no 'Timing budgets' phase in its output. Touches Makefile, cmd/rhiza/makeupdate_test.go, AGENTS.md (the '(and the timing budgets)' lock sentence and make test's description). Must not drop a budget test from test-budgets or change a budget limit.
fields.statement: make test and make check no longer run the timing budgets: the budget phase leaves make test's recipe, the budgets run only in the opt-in make test-budgets (alone, -count=1 -p 1, printing the read-budget timings), which CI's budgets job runs on every pull request, and AGENTS.md and the Makefile's comments say so.

fields.question: How much should the backdating leaf be expected to cut, locally and in CI's budgets job?
fields.reasoning: The drafted 60 s was below what removing every racy-window sleep can reach: 160 s minus about 97 s of sleeps leaves about 63 s of real work on the VM, so 75 s gives margin for load without allowing a sleep to stay. CI's internal/api budgets step is about 141 s; the same 97 s of wall-clock sleeps come off it, leaving about 45 s, so the job's 233 s median falls to about 135 s.
fields.statement: After backdating, internal/api's three budget tests run -count=1 -p 1 must finish within 75 s on the VM (from 160 s, of which about 97 s are 44 racy-window sleeps), and CI's budgets job is expected to drop from a 233 s median to about 135 s, under the 3-minute CI target

fields.question: BUDGET_TESTS names TestGeneratedModel, which no package holds any more: drop it or keep it?
fields.reasoning: A name in BUDGET_TESTS that matches no test keeps a dead entry in every -run and -skip; no budget is lost by dropping it, since the test it named no longer exists anywhere in the repo.
fields.statement: TestGeneratedModel is dropped from BUDGET_TESTS and from the tests that spell the budget regex: it lived in internal/tui/modelapp, which was deleted (PR #301), and no package holds it now
